competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Most of the headline XRP open-interest spread reflects different venue and instrument universes rather than a true market change.
supporting_evidence: TradRadar explicitly covers seven exchanges' perpetual futures.
TRdesk explicitly covers 26 exchanges and includes perpetual swaps plus quarterly futures.
TRdesk identifies CME as approximately 20.4% of its aggregate.
disconfirming_or_missing: Common-venue values differ materially across providers, including Bybit and Gate.
TRdesk's exact observation timestamp was not displayed.
No raw exchange contract-level API reconciliation was completed.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Contract multiplier, quote-currency, inverse/linear contract or venue mapping differences explain part of the residual spread.
supporting_evidence: Common-venue aggregate values differ materially even where venues overlap.
Provider pages expose different contract scopes and not all raw payloads.
disconfirming_or_missing: The exact mapping error has not been identified.
A contract-by-contract comparison is still required.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Positive weekly ETF/index holdings changes despite a falling XRP price may indicate some persistent allocation interest.
supporting_evidence: XRP Insights reports +3.39M XRP weekly holdings change for Oct 26-30.
Reported price fell approximately 3.8% over the same week.
disconfirming_or_missing: The weekly change is approximately 0.28% of existing holdings and 0.27% of AUM.
BITW is an index product, GXRP flow rows are excluded where data is missing, and some rows are reconstructed.
A holdings delta is not automatically cash inflow.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Differences among ETF flow dashboards are caused primarily by different fund universes, partial issuer reporting and flow definitions.
supporting_evidence: XRP Insights uses six spot funds plus BITW and excludes GXRP flow rows where its scrape gap exists.
CryptoETF.today explicitly reports only three of five funds for Oct 30.
disconfirming_or_missing: A full issuer-file reconciliation across all funds has not been completed.
No common fund-universe daily XRP-unit table has been produced.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Circle Q3 results may materially clarify USDC reserve economics, Coinbase distribution dependence and the scale of Arc/payment-network activity.
supporting_evidence: Circle has scheduled a public Q3 results webcast for Nov 4 at 8 AM ET.
The official investor page identifies a shareholder Q&A window closing Nov 3 at 9 AM ET.
disconfirming_or_missing: No Q3 results are available at this snapshot cutoff.
The event may not disclose chain-level XRP or XRPL activity.

unresolved_no_edge_assertions: No direct relationship between Tokyo SBIC and XRP, XRPL, Ripple, Circle or SBI Holdings is established by the reviewed training page.
No direct XRP or XRPL integration was established for Permission Coin ASK in the reviewed official documentation.
No XRP price forecast is inferred from provider open-interest totals or modelled liquidation heatmaps.
